d4ec26dc89ba9a6fcab91d7e.title_original: On Emergent Capabilities and Model Merging
d4ec26dc89ba9a6fcab91d7e.excerpt: arXiv:2609.24504v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Fine-tuned checkpoints and adapters now fill public repositories, and the most common operation applied to these artifacts is model merging: arithmetic on their weights that assembles capabilities cheaply. We ask what this operation does to emergent capabilities: behaviors an artifact carries that were never an explicit training target. Studying two independent testbeds (activation oracles and emergent-misaligned models) across three model families, we find that the answer is threefold. First, merging preserves an emergent capability that both parents carry: merging two misaligned checkpoints retains most of their broad misalignment across the whole mixing range. Second, merging cannot create an emergent capability that is superadditive in its parents: no weighted merge of two single-task oracles reaches the jointly-trained oracle's auditing ability. Third, when only one parent carries the capability, merging dilutes it faster than the trained capability that accompanies it: the gap is significant in most settings. In short, emergent behaviors of an artifact do not compose the way its trained capability does.

1c5d512b14bbd188c1a60f00.title_original: Mitigating LLM Over-Refusal via Dynamic Semantic Routing Calibration
1c5d512b14bbd188c1a60f00.excerpt: arXiv:2609.25049v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) aligned for safety often suffer from over-refusal, incorrectly rejecting benign yet safety-related instructions. Prior studies primarily attribute this to static representation overlap, largely overlooking the underlying dynamic mechanisms. In this paper, we present the mechanistic analysis of over-refusal through the lens of internal routing conflicts within transformer attention. We discover that a sparse subset of Hypersensitive Safety Heads misfires on Hard-Safe prompts, exhibiting abnormal attention entanglement that forcefully binds harmless target entities to refusal semantics. This triggers a severe, high-entropy routing conflict that deprives target entities of necessary attention. To counteract this, we propose Semantic Routing Calibration (SRC), a lightweight, training-free inference framework. SRC precisely localizes and dynamically suppresses these hypersensitive safety heads at the inference stage. Coupled with a dual-branch logits fusion that acts as a safety regularizer during subsequent decoding, SRC seamlessly restores trustworthy reasoning. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SRC alleviates over-refusal, with intrinsic safety performance preserved as much as feasible.

7017f6ccafa19b6fe7a94ea6.title_original: Compliant AI Infrastructure for Regulated Finance: A tiered multi-agent framework with DLT audit trails for financial operations in DACH
7017f6ccafa19b6fe7a94ea6.excerpt: arXiv:2609.27632v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We present a compliance-first architecture for AI in regulated finance that treats regulation as an orientation layer rather than a deterministic ruleset. A matrix of regulatory intent and exposure provides a compact classification handle, which a governed policy compiler then maps into concrete prohibitions, obligations and runtime budgets. Prohibitions constrain feasibility and block externalisation, while obligations extend tasks with artefacts that must meet explicit admissibility criteria. Committee activation remains policy-driven and proportionate, preserving efficiency while ensuring supervisory oversight. Evidence, decisions and reason codes are bound to a permissioned DAG with deterministic timestamping, enabling replay, provenance checks and clear attribution of failure. Clause-level legal indexing with effective dates and capability-based agent routing ensure portability across DACH and the wider EU. The result is assurance by construction: compliance is embedded in execution and verifiable by auditors without sacrificing proportionality or transparency.

ea5ee6c15078b0aad65ab985.title_original: What Does a Skill Actually Do? Estimands and Evaluation Validity for Tool and Skill Use in LLM Agents: A Critical Review
ea5ee6c15078b0aad65ab985.excerpt: arXiv:2609.33153v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Reported improvements from tools and reusable skills in large language model agents refer to different comparisons. This critical narrative review examines what these evaluations estimate and which conclusions their designs support. The review checks the roles of one hundred cited papers and extracts focal evaluation designs in detail from thirty-five studies. Targeted readings of thirty-five additional published or accepted studies broaden coverage of tool creation, memory, interactive benchmarks, reliability, and risk. Designs are characterized by treatment contrast, target population, outcome, budget constraint, summary measure, and identification assumptions. Analytic decompositions and counterexamples show that pairing runs on the same task does not itself identify an invocation effect when evaluation conditions on a trigger within the treated run. Paired gain and regression counts describe discordance under the coupling protocol rather than the share of tasks whose expected outcomes worsen. Total effects of deploying a module answer a different question from efficiency under a common budget. Comparisons across studies distinguish curated skill provision from retriever replacement, task populations from triggered subsets, and preparation costs from marginal usage costs. Publication status and reading depth are recorded. The review provides a methodological synthesis and a reporting checklist to help align claims a

b9c437e6df6060834e6b136d.title_original: Unifying Video Tasks via Spatiotemporal Analogy
b9c437e6df6060834e6b136d.excerpt: arXiv:2609.33935v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Adapting video models to new tasks typically requires dedicated data curation and fine-tuning. While visual analogy provides a training-free alternative by specifying tasks in-context, it remains restricted to the image domain. To explore whether analogy-based methods can unify diverse video tasks and generalize to out-of-distribution scenarios, we introduce ViGeo, a framework that extends visual in-context learning to the video domain via spatiotemporal canvas completion. Evaluated on a diverse task taxonomy with a strict train-test split, ViGeo generalizes to unseen video manipulations and zero-shot modalities (e.g., event cameras). Finally, we identify task internalization, where a query format associated with a pretrained task overrides the demonstration, and show that this shortcut can be removed with a small amount of task-unrelated data, highlighting the need to decorrelate prompt format from task identity.

16b45576b481b75e99d63fe0.title_original: Triangular Resampling for Long-Horizon Motion Generation
16b45576b481b75e99d63fe0.excerpt: arXiv:2609.34697v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We introduce Triangular Resampling (TR), a post-training method for mitigating long-horizon error accumulation in motion diffusion models. Built on FloodDiffusion's triangular denoising schedule, TR addresses the mismatch between ground-truth-derived training windows and model-generated inference states. Replacing only completed motion history leaves this mismatch unresolved in partially denoised states within the active window. TR therefore extends rollout-based training to these states, using ground-truth clamping to limit excessive drift. For each replayed sample, TR draws one denoising threshold, shared across latent positions and replay updates, and replays multi-step triangular denoising without gradient tracking. After each update, states below the threshold are replaced with noise-matched ground truth, while those at or above it retain model predictions. The resulting latent window enters the standard training update. This rollout construction supports both supervised training (TR) and distribution matching (TR-DMD). On 120-second motion generation from HumanML3D test prompts, TR and TR-DMD achieve state-of-the-art FID AUC within their respective non-DMD and DMD comparison groups. Supervised TR reduces FID AUC by 40.9% and FID degradation slope by 55.3% relative to matched post-training without replay.

c1fc58960988753783f9a641.title_original: A Proposed Rubric for Evaluating Expressed Clinical Reasoning in Large Language Model Responses
c1fc58960988753783f9a641.excerpt: arXiv:2609.37788v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We propose a rubric for assessing expressed clinical reasoning in model responses, drawing on three bodies of work: medical education assessment frameworks (ART, SCT, Key Feature Problems and OSCE); clinical LLM benchmarks (MedR-Bench, HealthBench, TIMER-Bench, DR. BENCH, PrIME-LLM and PatientSafeBench); and general LLM reasoning evaluation research, including the Factuality-Validity-Coherence-Utility taxonomy, FaithCoT-Bench and C2-Faith. We use groundedness as a clinically oriented adaptation of the taxonomy's factuality category. The rubric brings these concepts together in a multidimensional framework for scoring free-text responses to gold-standard clinical vignettes. It includes provisional behavioural anchors, applicability rules and a separate flag for case-specific safety-critical errors. General-domain frameworks inform its design but are not treated as validated clinical instruments. The rubric does not replace case-specific reference criteria or the task-specific metrics of existing benchmarks. It has not yet been tested for inter-rater reliability, construct validity or clinical utility. Its immediate purpose is to make evaluation decisions explicit and open to scrutiny before empirical testing.

CVE-2026-103065.description: Improper Validation of Specified Quantity in Input vulnerability in Themeum Kirki kirki allows Accessing Functionality Not Properly Constrained by ACLs.This issue affects Kirki: from n/a through 6.3.1.

CVE-2026-103342.description: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Unlimited Elements Unlimited Elements For Elementor (Free Widgets, Addons, Templates) unlimited-elements-for-elementor allows Reflected XSS.This issue affects Unlimited Elements For Elementor (Free Widgets, Addons, Templates): from n/a through 2.0.20.
CVE-2026-103342.summary_ko: Unlimited Elements For Elementor 2.0.20 버전 이하에서 웹페이지 생성 중 입력값 부적절한 무해화로 인해 반사형 크로스사이트스크립팅(XSS) 취약점이 발생합니다.

CVE-2026-96451.description: Authorization Bypass Through User-Controlled Key vulnerability in Ultimate Member Ultimate Member ultimate-member allows Privilege Escalation.This issue affects Ultimate Member: from n/a through 2.13.1.
CVE-2026-96451.summary_ko: Ultimate Member 플러그인의 사용자 제어 키를 통한 권한 우회 취약점으로 인해 권한 상승이 발생할 수 있습니다. 이 문제는 n/a부터 2.13.1 버전까지의 Ultimate Member에 영향을 미칩니다.

CVE-2026-105123.description: W (vincent-peugnet/wcms) through 3.18.0 contains a remote code execution vulnerability that allows authenticated editors to write arbitrary files by abusing the unvalidated path in POST /api/v0/media/upload/[*:path]. Attackers can upload .php files executed by the web server, use encoded ../ sequences to write outside the media directory, and delete arbitrary files via DELETE /api/v0/media/[*:path].
CVE-2026-105123.summary_ko: W(vincent-peugnet/wcms) 3.18.0 버전 이하에서 인증된 편집자가 임의의 파일을 작성하고 임의의 파일을 삭제할 수 있는 원격 코드 실행 취약점이 존재합니다. 미디어 업로드 경로의 검증 부재를 악용합니다.

CVE-2026-105124.description: W (vincent-peugnet/wcms) through 3.18.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to inject scripts via the login user field and visitor comment website field. Attackers can submit failed logins rendered unescaped in the adminlog.php log viewer, or comment URLs echoed into href attributes in editrightbar.php, executing script with administrator or editor privileges.
CVE-2026-105124.summary_ko: W(vincent-peugnet/wcms) 3.18.0 버전 이하에서 인증되지 않은 공격자가 로그인 사용자 필드와 방문자 댓글 웹사이트 필드를 통해 스크립트를 주입할 수 있는 저장형 크로스 사이트 스크립팅 취약점이 존재합니다.

CVE-2026-105125.description: LaraDashboard before 1.4.8 contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to read JSON files by manipulating the {lang} route segment. On Windows hosts, attackers can send URL-encoded backslash sequences like ..%5C to escape resources/lang and read composer.json or other application JSON files.
CVE-2026-105125.summary_ko: LaraDashboard 1.4.8 버전 미만에서 인증되지 않은 공격자가 경로 순회 취약점을 통해 윈도우 호스트에서 URL 인코딩된 역슬래시 시퀀스를 사용하여 composer.json 등의 JSON 파일을 읽을 수 있습니다.

CVE-2026-105126.description: LaraDashboard before 1.4.8 contains an improper privilege management vulnerability that allows authenticated Admin users to escalate to Superadmin by editing or renaming roles. Attackers with role.edit can rename their role to Superadmin or grant user.login_as permissions to take over accounts and reach core upgrade and module installation functions for code execution.
CVE-2026-105126.summary_ko: LaraDashboard 1.4.8 버전 미만에서 인증된 관리자가 역할 수정이나 이름을 변경하여 슈퍼관리자로 권한을 상승시킬 수 있는 부적절한 권한 관리 취약점이 존재합니다.

CVE-2026-105127.description: LaraDashboard 1.4.2 before 1.4.8 applies advanced email validation to unauthenticated forgot-password and reset-password requests, triggering DNS lookups and paid AbstractAPI verification calls. Unauthenticated attackers can submit arbitrary addresses to exhaust the verification quota, making validation fail open for all public forms, and probe domain resolution.
CVE-2026-105127.summary_ko: LaraDashboard 1.4.8 버전 미만에서 인증되지 않은 비밀번호 찾기 및 재설정 요청 시 고급 이메일 검증으로 인해 DNS 조회와 외부 API 검증 호출이 트리거되어 할당량이 소진될 수 있습니다.

CVE-2026-105128.description: LaraDashboard before 1.4.8 contains an open redirect vulnerability that allows remote attackers to redirect users by supplying an unvalidated redirect_url parameter to EmailTemplateController builder and builderEdit. Attackers can send crafted builder links to logged-in users with email template permissions so saving a template navigates them to attacker-controlled phishing sites.
CVE-2026-105128.summary_ko: LaraDashboard 1.4.8 버전 미만에서 검증되지 않은 redirect_url 매개변수로 인해 이메일 템플릿 빌더에서 사용자가 공격자가 제어하는 피싱 사이트로 리디렉션될 수 있는 개방형 리디렉션 취약점이 존재합니다.

CVE-2026-105129.description: LaraDashboard before 1.4.8 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated users with only settings.view permission to read stored secrets through the settings API. Attackers can query GET /api/settings or /api/settings/{option_name} to retrieve plaintext AI provider API keys, mail credentials, passwords and tokens.
CVE-2026-105129.summary_ko: LaraDashboard 1.4.8 버전 미만에서 settings.view 권한만 가진 인증된 사용자가 설정 API를 통해 저장된 비밀 키, 메일 자격 증명, 비밀번호 등을 읽을 수 있는 잘못된 권한 부여 취약점이 존재합니다.

CVE-2026-105130.description: LaraDashboard from 1.4.0 before 1.4.8 contains a race condition vulnerability in RegisterController::register that allows unauthenticated attackers to bypass the per-IP daily registration limit. Attackers can send many concurrent registration requests from one IP so all pass RegistrationGuardService::hasExceededIpLimit before recordRegistration runs, creating accounts in bulk and defeating anti-automation controls.
CVE-2026-105130.summary_ko: LaraDashboard 1.4.8 버전 미만의 RegisterController에서 인증되지 않은 공격자가 동시 요청을 통해 IP별 일일 등록 제한을 우회하여 대량의 계정을 생성할 수 있는 경쟁 상태 취약점이 존재합니다.

CVE-2026-105096.description: A vulnerability was determined in Omega Solution CoinEx Crypto 2025. This affects an unknown function of the file /customer/ of the component Customer Profile API. Executing a manipulation of the argument ID can lead to authorization bypass. The attack may be launched remotely. The exploit has been publicly disclosed and may be utilized. The product web site does not exist anymore. Maybe the product got retired and/or replaced. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.
CVE-2026-105096.summary_ko: Omega Solution CoinEx Crypto 2025의 고객 프로필 API 컴포넌트 내 /customer/ 파일에서 ID 인자 조작으로 인해 권한 우회 취약점이 발생합니다. 원격에서 공격이 수행될 수 있습니다.

CVE-2026-105131.description: ezBookkeeping 1.2.0 before 2.0.1 contains a privilege escalation vulnerability that allows attackers holding an API token to obtain a full session token via /api/v1/tokens/refresh.json. Because TokenRefreshHandler never checks token type, attackers can exchange short-lived or IP-restricted API tokens for 30-day normal session tokens that bypass API token expiry and allowlists.
CVE-2026-105131.summary_ko: ezBookkeeping 2.0.1 버전 미만에서 API 토큰을 보유한 공격자가 토큰 유형을 확인하지 않는 취약점으로 인해 제한된 API 토큰을 30일짜리 일반 세션 토큰으로 교환하여 권한을 획득할 수 있습니다.

CVE-2026-105097.description: A vulnerability was identified in Omega Solution CoinEx Crypto 2025. This impacts an unknown function of the file /customer-currency/ of the component Customer Information API. The manipulation of the argument ID leads to authorization bypass. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. The exploit is publicly available and might be used. The product web site does not exist anymore. Maybe the product got retired and/or replaced. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

CVE-2026-105098.description: A security flaw has been discovered in Omega Solution CoinEx Crypto 2025. Affected is an unknown function of the file /ticket/customer of the component Support Ticket API. The manipulation of the argument status/page/count results in information disclosure. The attack can be executed remotely. The exploit has been released to the public and may be used for attacks. The product web site does not exist anymore. Maybe the product got retired and/or replaced. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

CVE-2026-88779.description: Vulnerability in NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway. This issue affects ADC: before 14.1-73.41, before 13.1-64.28, before 14.1-73.41 FIPS, and before 13.1-37.282; Gateway: before 14.1-73.41 and before 13.1-64.28.

kev.required_action: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.
kev.vulnerability_name: Citrix NetScaler Improper Restriction of Operations within the Bounds of a Memory Buffer Vulnerability

CVE-2026-88779.summary_ko: NetScaler ADC 및 NetScaler Gateway 제품에 취약점이 존재합니다. 명시된 이전 버전들이 영향을 받습니다.

CVE-2026-105099.description: A weakness has been identified in Omega Solution CoinEx Crypto 2025. Affected by this vulnerability is an unknown functionality of the file /user/ticket of the component Ticket Attachment Upload. This manipulation causes cross site scripting. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. The exploit has been made available to the public and could be used for attacks. The product web site does not exist anymore. Maybe the product got retired and/or replaced. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

CVE-2026-104118.description: The Razorpay for WooCommerce WordPress plugin before 4.8.8 does not perform ownership or authorization checks on a REST API route used during checkout, allowing unauthenticated attackers to modify the shipping information stored on arbitrary orders.
CVE-2026-104118.summary_ko: Razorpay for WooCommerce WordPress 플러그인 4.8.8 미만 버전은 결제 중 사용되는 REST API 경로에 대해 소유권이나 권한 검사를 수행하지 않습니다. 이로 인해 인증되지 않은 공격자가 임의 주문에 저장된 배송 정보를 수정할 수 있습니다.

CVE-2026-104119.description: The Simple Shopping Cart WordPress plugin before 5.2.6 does not escape some of its settings field values before outputting them on an admin settings page, allowing high-privilege users such as administrators to perform Stored Cross-Site Scripting attacks, which is notably impactful on multisite installations where administrators do not have the unfiltered_html capability.
CVE-2026-104119.summary_ko: Simple Shopping Cart WordPress 플러그인 5.2.6 미만 버전은 관리자 설정 페이지에 출력하기 전에 일부 설정 필드 값을 이스케이프 처리하지 않습니다. 이로 인해 관리자와 같은 고권한 사용자가 저장된 크로스 사이트 스크립팅(Stored XSS) 공격을 수행할 수 있습니다.

CVE-2026-105133.description: A vulnerability was detected in Ahsay AhsayCBS up to 10.3.2. This affects the function checkSysPwd of the file com/ahsay/obs/api/ApiStructsAction.java of the component API. Performing a manipulation of the argument random results in improper authentication. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. The exploit is now public and may be used. Upgrading to version 10.3.4 is able to mitigate this issue. It is recommended to upgrade the affected component.
CVE-2026-105133.summary_ko: Ahsay AhsayCBS 10.3.2 이하 버전의 API 구성요소에서 취약점이 감지되었습니다. random 인자 조작으로 인해 부적절한 인증 문제가 발생할 수 있습니다.

CVE-2026-105134.description: A flaw has been found in Ahsay AhsayCBS up to 10.3.2. This vulnerability affects unknown code of the file /rps/api/json/UpdateReceivers.do of the component Replication Receiver. Executing a manipulation of the argument random can lead to os command injection. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The exploit has been published and may be used. Upgrading to version 10.3.4 is able to resolve this issue. Upgrading the affected component is advised.
CVE-2026-105134.summary_ko: Ahsay AhsayCBS 10.3.2 이하 버전의 Replication Receiver 구성요소에서 결함이 발견되었습니다. random 인자 조작으로 인해 운영체제(OS) 명령어 주입이 발생할 수 있습니다.

CVE-2026-105135.description: A vulnerability has been found in InternLM MindSearch 0.1.0. This issue affects the function ExecutionAction.run of the file mindsearch/agent/graph.py of the component Planner Agent. The manipulation of the argument inputs leads to code injection. The attack can be initiated remotely. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.
CVE-2026-105135.summary_ko: InternLM MindSearch 0.1.0 버전의 Planner Agent에 있는 ExecutionAction.run 함수에서 취약점이 발견되었습니다. 입력값 조작으로 인해 코드 주입이 발생할 수 있습니다.

CVE-2026-17005.description: The Horizontal scrolling announcements WordPress plugin through 2.6 does not sanitise and escape one of its announcement settings before outputting it into an attribute context on the front end, allowing users granted access to the announcement management page (Contributor and above, once permitted) to perform Stored Cross-Site Scripting attacks that execute in the browser of anyone viewing the announcement.
CVE-2026-17005.summary_ko: Horizontal scrolling announcements WordPress 플러그인 2.6 이하 버전은 프론트엔드의 속성 컨텍스트에 출력하기 전에 공지사항 설정을 살균 및 이스케이프 처리하지 않습니다. 이로 인해 공지사항 관리 권한이 있는 사용자가 저장된 크로스 사이트 스크립팅(Stored XSS) 공격을 수행할 수 있습니다.

CVE-2026-86817.description: The Five Star Business Profile and Schema WordPress plugin before 2.4.0 does not properly restrict the callbacks used to resolve schema field default values, allowing authenticated users with Author-level access and above to store input that discloses sensitive data, including other users' password hashes and arbitrary site option values, in public output readable by unauthenticated visitors.
CVE-2026-86817.summary_ko: Five Star Business Profile and Schema WordPress 플러그인 2.4.0 미만 버전은 스키마 필드 기본값을 확인하는 콜백을 적절히 제한하지 않습니다. 작성자 수준 이상의 권한을 가진 사용자가 민감한 데이터가 포함된 입력을 저장할 수 있습니다.

CVE-2026-93549.description: The CoCart WordPress plugin before 4.9.7 does not scope its REST API authentication filter to its own endpoints, which disables WordPress core's REST nonce protection for every route, allowing an attacker to perform a cross-site request forgery attack that creates a new administrator account using a logged-in administrator's session.
CVE-2026-93549.summary_ko: CoCart WordPress 플러그인 4.9.7 미만 버전은 REST API 인증 필터를 자체 엔드포인트로 제한하지 않습니다. 이로 인해 인증되지 않은 공격자가 크로스 사이트 요청 위조(CSRF) 공격을 수행하여 관리자 계정을 생성할 수 있습니다.

CVE-2026-97332.description: The User Private Files WordPress plugin before 2.2.0 does not properly protect its stored private files on multisite installations, where the rewrite rule it relies on to route file requests through its access check is never reached, allowing unauthenticated users to retrieve other users' private files directly.
CVE-2026-97332.summary_ko: User Private Files WordPress 플러그인 2.2.0 미만 버전은 멀티사이트 설치 환경에서 저장된 비공개 파일을 적절히 보호하지 않습니다. 이로 인해 인증되지 않은 사용자가 다른 사용자의 비공개 파일을 직접 가져올 수 있습니다.

CVE-2026-103062.description: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Cozmoslabs TranslatePress translatepress-multilingual allows Stored XSS.This issue affects TranslatePress: from n/a through 3.3.6.

CVE-2026-103344.description: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Unlimited Elements Unlimited Elements For Elementor (Free Widgets, Addons, Templates) unlimited-elements-for-elementor allows Reflected XSS.This issue affects Unlimited Elements For Elementor (Free Widgets, Addons, Templates): from n/a through 2.0.20.

CVE-2026-103354.description: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Liquid Web / StellarWP Gutenberg Blocks by Kadence Blocks kadence-blocks allows Stored XSS.This issue affects Gutenberg Blocks by Kadence Blocks: from n/a through 3.7.11.1.

CVE-2026-103355.description: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection') vulnerability in Unlimited Elements Unlimited Elements For Elementor (Free Widgets, Addons, Templates) unlimited-elements-for-elementor allows Blind SQL Injection.This issue affects Unlimited Elements For Elementor (Free Widgets, Addons, Templates): from n/a through 2.0.20.

CVE-2026-105137.description: A vulnerability was found in Laradock up to 20.4. Impacted is an unknown function of the file workspace/Dockerfile of the component Build Process. The manipulation results in download of code without integrity check. The attack can be launched remotely. A high complexity level is associated with this attack. The exploitability is considered difficult. The exploit has been made public and could be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

CVE-2026-105141.description: A security flaw has been discovered in topoteretes cognee up to 1.5.4. The affected element is the function get_user_id_by_email of the file cognee/modules/users/authentication/get_api_auth_backend.py of the component JWT Signing Key Handler. The manipulation of the argument FASTAPI_USERS_JWT_SECRET results in hard-coded credentials. The attack may be launched remotely. Upgrading to version 1.6.0 is sufficient to fix this issue. The patch is identified as fa65fc0cd86cdba48d19aa76e36be862be982f5d. Upgrading the affected component is advised.

CVE-2026-105144.description: A flaw has been found in Drogon up to 1.9.13-1/10.0-beta.3 on Windows. Affected is the function StaticFileRouter::route of the file lib/src/StaticFileRouter.cc of the component Static File Router. Executing a manipulation can lead to path traversal. The attack may be performed from remote. The exploit has been published and may be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

CVE-2026-97276.description: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in VeronaLabs WP Statistics wp-statistics allows Reflected XSS.This issue affects WP Statistics: from n/a through 14.16.14.

CVE-2026-105145.description: A vulnerability has been found in Weaviate Verba up to 2.1.3. Affected by this vulnerability is the function get_environment of the file goldenverba/components/util.py of the component generate_stream Endpoint. The manipulation leads to information disclosure. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

CVE-2026-105146.description: A vulnerability was found in Comsenz Discuz! X5.0-20260801/X5.0-20260820/X5.0-20260910. Affected by this issue is the function modmedalsubmit of the file upload/source/app/admin/child/medals/mod.php of the component Admin Medal Moderation. The manipulation of the argument delete results in sql injection. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The exploit has been made public and could be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

CVE-2026-97307.description: Insertion of Sensitive Information Into Sent Data vulnerability in StylemixThemes Cost Calculator Builder cost-calculator-builder allows Retrieve Embedded Sensitive Data.This issue affects Cost Calculator Builder: from n/a through 4.0.17.

CVE-2026-105147.description: A vulnerability was determined in SciPhi-AI R2R up to 3.6.6. This affects an unknown part of the component JWT Secret Handler. This manipulation of the argument DEFAULT_BCRYPT_SECRET_KEY/DEFAULT_NACL_SECRET_KEY causes hard-coded credentials. The attack can be initiated remotely. The exploit has been publicly disclosed and may be utilized. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

CVE-2026-105148.description: A vulnerability was identified in SciPhi-AI R2R up to 3.6.6. This vulnerability affects unknown code of the file py/shared/abstractions/llm.py of the component Retrieval Completion API Endpoint. Such manipulation of the argument generation_config.api_base leads to server-side request forgery. The attack can be launched remotely. The exploit is publicly available and might be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

CVE-2026-105149.description: A security flaw has been discovered in mooSocial up to 3.2.4. This issue affects some unknown processing of the file /stores/all-products. Performing a manipulation of the argument rating results in sql injection. The attack may be initiated remotely. The exploit has been released to the public and may be used for attacks. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

d04ef3e2d9321ad14ec9c5d8.excerpt: Makes your AI agent think like the laziest senior dev in the room. The best code is the code you never wrote.
d04ef3e2d9321ad14ec9c5d8.summary_ko: AI 에이전트가 가장 게으른 시니어 개발자처럼 생각하도록 만들어주는 오픈소스 저장소 프로젝트이다. 작성하지 않은 코드가 가장 좋은 코드라는 철학을 바탕으로 AI의 동작 방식을 구현한다.

curation.reason_ko: 불필요한 코드 작성을 억제하도록 돕는 시니어 개발자 콘셉트 AI 에이전트

813efc0868399bed398b4b26.excerpt: Give your AI agent eyes to see the entire internet. Read & search Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub, Bilibili, XiaoHongShu — one CLI, zero API fees.
813efc0868399bed398b4b26.title_ko: AI 에이전트에 인터넷 검색 기능을 부여하는 오픈소스 도구 'Agent-Reach'
813efc0868399bed398b4b26.summary_ko: 트위터, 레딧, 유튜브, 깃허브 등 다양한 플랫폼의 데이터를 AI 에이전트가 단일 CLI와 무료로 검색하고 읽을 수 있도록 지원하는 오픈소스 저장소 프로젝트다.

curation.reason_ko: AI 에이전트가 주요 SNS와 웹 데이터를 단일 CLI로 검색·수집하는 도구

5748c0f04a827c38aa243346.title_ko: 앤트로픽, 클로드 코드에 '알아야 할 사항' 보조 에이전트 플러그인 공개
5748c0f04a827c38aa243346.summary_ko: 앤트로픽이 클로드 코드에 메인 에이전트의 작업을 지켜보며 중요한 내용을 요약해 주는 보조 에이전트 플러그인 '알아야 할 사항'을 추가했다. 이 기능은 복잡한 코딩 작업 중 사용자가 놓치기 쉬운 결정을 환기해 주는 역할을 한다. 백그라운드 토큰 소모 등에 대한 우려도 존재하나 명시적인 사용자 제어 하에 활성화되도록 설계되었다.

curation.reason_ko: 클로드 코드에 메인 에이전트 작업을 모니터링하는 보조 감시 플러그인 탑재

28d0a7e0e84a2e616f2670f4.title_ko: 금융당국, 잇단 침해사고에 전 금융권 긴급 점검 및 보안 강화 주문
28d0a7e0e84a2e616f2670f4.summary_ko: 금융위원회와 금융감독원 등 관계기관이 전 금융권을 소집해 긴급 점검회의를 열고 정보보안 체계를 원점에서 재점검하도록 주문했다. 최근 대출모집인 및 임직원 업무시스템 등 관리 취약 영역을 노린 사이버공격이 확인됨에 따라 외부 접근 차단 및 보안 패치를 강조했다. 당국은 보안을 비용이 아닌 필수 투자로 규정하며 제로트러스트 기반의 보안 체계 고도화를 촉구했다.

curation.reason_ko: 금융권 연쇄 침해에 대응한 금융당국의 긴급 점검 및 제로트러스트 요구

c2f0ec3134f68f80124de351.title_ko: 한국전력, 외부 웹페이지 통해 직원 2만 4000여 명 개인정보 노출
c2f0ec3134f68f80124de351.summary_ko: 한국전력은 외부 웹페이지에 직원 2만 4000여 명의 이름, 소속, 전화번호 등 개인정보가 노출된 사고가 발생했다고 밝혔다. 주민등록번호나 고객 정보는 포함되지 않은 것으로 확인되었다. 한전은 사고 인지 후 즉시 시스템 접속을 차단하고 삭제 조치를 취했으며 피해 예방과 구제 절차를 안내하고 있다.

curation.reason_ko: 외부 웹페이지 통해 한전 직원 2만 4천여 명의 개인정보 노출 사고 발생

2dc0133109004ef584127dba.title_ko: 중국 연계 해킹 그룹 TA419, 미국 AI 정책 전문가 대상 피싱 공격
2dc0133109004ef584127dba.summary_ko: 중국 연계 사이버 스파이 그룹 TA419가 미국 싱크탱크와 대학 등의 인공지능 정책 전문가들을 겨냥해 자격증명 피싱 캠페인을 벌였다. 이들은 클로드 관련 피싱 미끼를 사용해 마이크로소프트 인증 흐름을 가로채는 정교한 중간자 공격 기법을 활용했다. 전문가들은 패스키 등 피싱 저항 인증 도입을 권고받았다.

curation.reason_ko: 미국 AI 정책 전문가를 겨냥한 정교한 AitM 자격증명 피싱 공격 발생

0a8f3c1669a475bc83c6a2a7.title_ko: 구글, 컨테이너 보안 프로젝트 'gVisor' CNCF에 기증 추진
0a8f3c1669a475bc83c6a2a7.summary_ko: 구글이 gVisor의 이름과 상표를 포함한 프로젝트를 CNCF에 기증하며 거버넌스 전환을 추진한다. 향후 샌드박스 단계로 전환하고 외부 유지관리자에게도 병합 권한을 부여할 예정이다.

curation.reason_ko: 구글 컨테이너 샌드박스 보안 프로젝트 gVisor의 CNCF 기증 및 개방

sources.message: 보관 기간 내 1358건 · NVD 공개일(KST) 기준 · 전체 페이지 조회 완료

CVE-2026-105207.description: ZITADEL 3.0.0 through 3.4.15 and 4.0.0 before 4.17.3 creates links between user accounts and external identity providers without verifying a primary factor or the caller's permission, including on identify-only Login V2 sessions and via the User Service V2 AddIDPLink endpoint. An unauthenticated attacker knowing a victim's login name can bind their own external IdP identity to the victim's account and then sign in as the victim.
CVE-2026-105207.summary_ko: ZITADEL은 외부 IDP와 사용자 계정을 연결할 때 기본 인증 요소나 호출 권한을 검증하지 않아, 공격자가 피해자 계정에 자신의 외부 IdP를 바인딩하고 로그인할 수 있는 취약점이 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: ZITADEL에서 외부 IdP 연결 시 인증 검증이 누락되어 계정명이 노출된 계정을 탈취할 수 있는 치명적 결함입니다.

CVE-2026-105209.description: ZITADEL 3.x before 3.4.15 and 4.x before 4.17.1 contains an improper authorization vulnerability: when issuing passkey or passwordless enrollment codes, it checks only the organization in the x-zitadel-orgid header, not the target user's organization. Attackers with user-write permission in one organization can obtain an enrollment code for a user in another organization on the same instance and register their own authenticator to take over that account.
CVE-2026-105209.summary_ko: ZITADEL은 패스키 등 등록 코드 발급 시 대상 사용자의 조직 대신 헤더의 조직만 확인하여, 다른 조직의 사용자 계정을 탈취할 수 있는 부적절한 인가 취약점이 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: ZITADEL 인스턴스 내 타 조직 사용자의 패스키 등록 코드를 발급받아 타 조직 계정을 탈취할 수 있습니다.

CVE-2026-105215.description: ZITADEL before 3.4.14 and 4.x before 4.16.2 contains an authentication bypass in the hosted Login V1 UI because the 'external account not found' registration endpoint trusts client-supplied external identity fields without a completed IdP callback. Unauthenticated attackers can submit forged IDPConfigID and ExternalUserID values to pre-create an account bound to a victim's external IdP identity, which the victim's later genuine external login then signs into.
CVE-2026-105215.summary_ko: ZITADEL Login V1 UI는 외부 계정 미발견 등록 엔드포인트가 외부 IdP 콜백 없이 클라이언트가 제공한 필드를 신뢰하여 인증을 우회할 수 있는 취약점이 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: ZITADEL Login V1에서 외부 IdP 콜백 검증 없이 임의 계정을 사전 생성 및 바인딩해 계정을 탈취합니다.

CVE-2026-105211.description: ZITADEL before 4.17.1 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in Login V2 that allows unauthenticated attackers to take over accounts by obtaining OTP codes via the returnCode delivery type. Attackers knowing a login name of a victim with OTP-Email and OTP-SMS enrolled can read both codes from server-action responses to gain MFA-authenticated sessions, including administrator takeover.
CVE-2026-105211.summary_ko: ZITADEL Login V2는 서버 액션 응답에서 OTP 코드를 읽어와 관리자 계정을 포함한 MFA 인증 세션을 탈취할 수 있는 인증 우회 취약점이 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: ZITADEL Login V2의 응답에서 OTP 코드를 가로채 관리자 계정 등 세션을 무단 탈취할 수 있습니다.

CVE-2026-105212.description: ZITADEL 3.x before 3.4.14 and 4.x before 4.16.2 contains an authentication bypass in the hosted Login V1 and Login V2 UIs that accepts passkey or other authenticator enrollment on identify-only login sessions, before any primary factor is verified. Unauthenticated attackers knowing only a victim's login name can register an attacker-controlled authenticator and log in as that user, bypassing existing passwords and MFA.
CVE-2026-105212.summary_ko: ZITADEL은 로그인 세션에서 기본 요소가 검증되기 전에 패스키 등 인증기 등록을 허용하여, 공격자가 비밀번호와 MFA를 우회하고 로그인할 수 있는 취약점이 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: ZITADEL 로그인 세션에서 기본 인증 없이 2차 인증 수단 및 패스키를 등록해 계정을 무단 장악합니다.

CVE-2026-105216.description: go-micro before 6.0.0 contains an improper certificate validation vulnerability that allows network attackers to impersonate services because the shared TLS helper sets InsecureSkipVerify to true by default. Man-in-the-middle attackers can present any certificate to intercept or modify gRPC transport, HTTP and RabbitMQ broker, and Consul or etcd registry traffic, including authentication tokens and credentials.
CVE-2026-105216.summary_ko: go-micro는 공유 TLS 헬퍼가 기본적으로 InsecureSkipVerify를 참으로 설정하여 부적절한 인증서 검증이 발생하며, 네트워크 중간자 공격자가 서비스를 가장할 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: go-micro 프레임워크가 기본적으로 TLS 인증서 검증을 건너뛰어 서비스 통신 도청 및 위장이 가능합니다.

CVE-2026-105218.description: gopay before 1.5.119 disables TLS certificate verification in defaultClient() in pkg/xhttp/client.go, allowing man-in-the-middle attackers to impersonate payment provider APIs. Attackers can present any certificate to read merchant credentials, signatures and transaction data, and modify payment, refund and order query responses.
CVE-2026-105218.summary_ko: gopay는 기본 클라이언트에서 TLS 인증서 검증을 비활성화하여, 중간자 공격자가 결제 제공자 API를 가장하고 자격 증명과 거래 데이터를 가로채거나 수정할 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: Go 결제 라이브러리 gopay의 TLS 검증 비활성화로 상점 자격 증명과 결제 거래 데이터가 변조될 위험이 있습니다.

CVE-2026-20519.description: In Modem, there is a possible out of bounds write due to a missing bounds check. This could lead to remote escalation of privilege, if a UE has connected to a rogue base station controlled by the attacker, with no additional execution privileges needed. User interaction is not needed for exploitation. Patch ID: MOLY01778993; Issue ID: MSV-8898.
CVE-2026-20519.summary_ko: Modem 컴포넌트에서 경계 검사 누락으로 인한 범위를 벗어난 쓰기 취약점이 존재합니다. 악의적인 기지국에 연결된 경우 원격 권한 상승으로 이어질 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: MediaTek 모뎀의 경계 검사 누락으로 악성 기지국 연결 시 사용자 상호작용 없이 원격 권한 상승이 발생합니다.

CVE-2026-20586.description: In vdec, there is a possible out of bounds write due to a missing bounds check. This could lead to remote escalation of privilege with no additional execution privileges needed. User interaction is needed for exploitation. Patch ID: ALPS11383899; Issue ID: MSV-9614.
CVE-2026-20586.summary_ko: vdec 컴포넌트에서 경계 검사 누락으로 인한 범위를 벗어난 쓰기 취약점이 존재합니다. 추가 실행 권한 없이 원격 권한 상승으로 이어질 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: MediaTek 비디오 디코더(vdec)의 버퍼 오버플로우로 인해 원격 권한 상승이 발생할 수 있습니다.

CVE-2026-105223.description: maclof kubernetes-client 0.17.0 before 0.32.0 disables TLS certificate verification in parseKubeconfig() and parseKubeconfigFile() when a kubeconfig lacks certificate-authority-data, ignoring insecure-skip-tls-verify. On-path attackers can impersonate the Kubernetes API server to capture Bearer tokens or Basic credentials and tamper with WebSocket or REST API traffic.
CVE-2026-105223.summary_ko: maclof kubernetes-client에서 인증서 권한 데이터가 없을 때 TLS 인증서 검증이 비활성화되는 문제가 있습니다. 경로상 공격자가 API 서버를 사칭하여 토큰과 자격 증명을 탈취할 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: 쿠버네티스 PHP 클라이언트에서 TLS 검증을 무시하여 토큰 탈취 및 API 통신 변조가 가능합니다.

CVE-2026-105208.description: ZITADEL 4.x before 4.17.3 and 3.x through 3.4.15 protects IdP intent tokens with unauthenticated, malleable encryption, allowing authenticated users to tamper with their own token so it is accepted for another user's external login intent. An attacker who predicts a victim's in-flight intent identifier and wins a timing race can call /v2/idp_intents or /v2/sessions to steal the victim's IdP tokens or hijack their session.
CVE-2026-105208.summary_ko: ZITADEL은 IdP 인텐트 토큰을 취약하게 보호하여, 공격자가 토큰을 조작하고 세션을 탈취하여 다른 사용자의 외부 로그인에 악용할 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: ZITADEL 인텐트 토큰의 취약한 암호화를 악용해 타이밍 경쟁으로 타 사용자의 IdP 세션을 가로챕니다.

CVE-2026-105220.description: Twine 2 desktop through 2.12.0 contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability in importStories() that executes markup from imported story files in the editor window. Attackers can craft a story file whose script calls the twineElectron openWithScratchFile IPC bridge to write and open a .bat file, executing code as the user.
CVE-2026-105220.summary_ko: Twine 2 데스크톱의 importStories() 함수에서 크로스 사이트 스크립팅(XSS) 취약점이 존재합니다. 공격자는 이를 악용해 제작된 스토리 파일을 통해 코드를 실행할 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: Twine 2 데스크톱에서 조작된 스토리 파일 임포트 시 일렉트론 IPC 브리지를 통해 임의 코드가 실행됩니다.

CVE-2026-105295.description: GitAhead 2.5.0 through 2.7.1 contains an insecure update mechanism that installs downloaded updates without integrity or signature verification and permanently ignores TLS errors after one SSL error dialog. Network attackers presenting an invalid certificate once can intercept later automatic update checks, offer a fake version, and execute code as the user upon installation.
CVE-2026-105295.summary_ko: GitAhead의 불안정한 업데이트 메커니즘으로 인해 무결성이나 서명 검증 없이 다운로드된 업데이트가 설치됩니다. 네트워크 공격자는 이를 가로채 가짜 버전을 제공하고 코드를 실행할 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: GitAhead의 서명 검증 없는 업데이트 및 TLS 오류 무시로 인해 악성 버전 설치 및 코드 실행이 발생합니다.

CVE-2026-105219.description: Mammoth.js 1.3.0 before 1.12.3 contains a regular expression denial of service vulnerability in the style map tokeniser in lib/styles/parser/tokeniser.js due to overlapping regex alternatives. Attackers can supply a crafted .docx with an unterminated quoted string of repeated backslash escapes in mammoth/style-map to block the Node.js event loop.
CVE-2026-105219.summary_ko: Mammoth.js는 스타일 맵 토크나이저의 정규식 문제로 인해 제작된 .docx 파일을 통해 노드 이벤트 루프를 차단할 수 있는 정규식 서비스 거부 취약점이 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: Mammoth.js 스타일 맵 파서의 정규식 결함으로 악성 docx 파일 처리 시 서비스 거부가 유발됩니다.

CVE-2026-105163.description: A vulnerability was detected in crossplane crossplane-runtime up to 2.2.2/2.3.2. This vulnerability affects the function Get of the file pkg/xpkg/client.go of the component ImageConfig. The manipulation results in time-of-check time-of-use. The attack may be launched remotely. Upgrading to version 2.2.3, 2.3.3 and 2.4.0-rc.1 is able to resolve this issue. The patch is identified as bee99c6cd6ca81878acca2940a2f0a02169fc208. You should upgrade the affected component.
CVE-2026-105163.summary_ko: crossplane-runtime의 pkg/xpkg/client.go 내 ImageConfig 컴포넌트에서 검사 시점과 사용 시점(TOCTOU) 취약점이 발견되었습니다. 원격으로 공격이 수행될 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: Crossplane 런타임의 ImageConfig 함수에서 발생하는 경쟁 상태(TOCTOU) 결함입니다.

CVE-2026-20538.description: In Modem, there is a possible out of bounds read due to a missing permission check. This could lead to remote denial of service, if a UE has connected to a rogue base station controlled by the attacker, with no additional execution privileges needed. User interaction is not needed for exploitation. Patch ID: MOLY01774038; Issue ID: MSV-8914.
CVE-2026-20538.summary_ko: Modem 컴포넌트에서 권한 검사 누락으로 인한 범위를 벗어난 읽기 취약점이 존재합니다. 악의적인 기지국에 연결된 경우 원격 서비스 거부로 이어질 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: MediaTek 모뎀이 악성 기지국에 연결될 때 경계 검사 실패로 원격 서비스 거부 상태가 발생합니다.

CVE-2026-20524.description: In apu, there is a possible memory corruption due to improper input validation. This could lead to local escalation of privilege with no additional execution privileges needed. User interaction is not needed for exploitation. Patch ID: ALPS11249004; Issue ID: MSV-9170.
CVE-2026-20524.summary_ko: apu 컴포넌트에서 부적절한 입력 검증으로 인한 메모리 손상 취약점이 존재합니다. 추가 권한 없이 로컬 권한 상승으로 이어질 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: MediaTek APU의 입력 유효성 검증 미흡으로 인한 메모리 손상으로 로컬 권한 상승이 가능합니다.

CVE-2026-105293.description: Legcord 1.1.0 through 1.3.0 contains a path traversal vulnerability in theme IPC handlers that allows script in the Discord page to escape the themes directory via unvalidated theme ids. Attackers running script in the Discord origin, such as through XSS, can abuse themes.folder, themes.uninstall, and themes.install to launch local executables, recursively delete directories, and write files outside the themes directory.
CVE-2026-105293.summary_ko: Legcord의 테마 IPC 핸들러에서 경로 순회 취약점이 존재합니다. 공격자는 이를 악용하여 로컬 실행 파일을 실행하고 디렉터리를 삭제하거나 파일을 쓸 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: Legcord 테마 IPC 핸들러의 경로 순회 결함으로 로컬 실행 파일 실행 및 임의 파일 조작이 가능합니다.

CVE-2026-105086.description: WWBN AVideo 12.4 through 29.2.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows authenticated uploaders to inject HTML by submitting doubly-encoded entities in video titles. CVE-2026-105086.summary_ko: WWBN AVideo는 비디오 제목에 이중 인코딩된 엔티티를 제출하여 HTML을 주입할 수 있는 저장형 크로스 사이트 스크립팅 취약점이 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: WWBN AVideo 동영상 플랫폼에서 비디오 제목 및 URL 이스케이프 미흡으로 저장형 XSS가 실행됩니다.

CVE-2026-105292.description: Chaterm before 0.12.1 contains a login cross-site request forgery vulnerability that allows remote attackers to inject login state by sending chaterm:// callbacks without OAuth state validation. Attackers can trigger a crafted callback with attacker-controlled userInfo from a web page, signing the victim into the attacker's account so default data sync uploads saved hosts, passwords, and private keys.
CVE-2026-105292.summary_ko: Chaterm에서 OAuth 상태 검증 없이 chaterm:// 콜백을 허용하여 로그인 크로스 사이트 요청 위조(CSRF) 취약점이 발생합니다. 공격자는 이를 통해 피해자를 공격자의 계정에 로그인시킬 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: Chaterm OAuth 콜백 검증 미흡으로 로그인 상태를 주입하여 저장된 호스트 및 암호를 유출합니다.

CVE-2026-105156.description: A weakness has been identified in YzmCMS up to 7.6. Impacted is the function Password of the file /common/function/system.func.php of the component MD5 Handler. Executing a manipulation of the argument pass can lead to password hash with insufficient computational effort. The attack may be launched remotely. This attack is characterized by high complexity. The exploitability is considered difficult. The exploit has been made available to the public and could be used for attacks. The vendor kindly explains: "Our regular release cycle is about 6 months. The last release was in the previous month, and our next scheduled version will be released in March 2027. We will implement the backward-compatible gradual hash migration feature in this upcoming release. (...) Before the new version is available, we will publish security mitigation guidance on our official documentation for existing deployers to reduce the risk."
CVE-2026-105156.summary_ko: YzmCMS 7.6 이하의 MD5 Handler 구성 요소에 취약점이 존재하며, pass 인자 조작 시 불충분한 연산량을 사용하는 비밀번호 해시 문제가 발생할 수 있습니다.

CVE-2026-105157.description: A security vulnerability has been detected in RainyGao DocSys up to 2.02.85. The affected element is the function DocController.doGetTmp of the file /Doc/doGetTmpFile.do of the component Document Controller. The manipulation of the argument path/fileName leads to path traversal. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. The exploit has been disclosed publicly and may be used. The project was informed of the problem early through an issue report but has not responded yet.
CVE-2026-105157.summary_ko: RainyGao DocSys 2.02.85 이하의 Document Controller 구성 요소에서 경로 순회 취약점이 발견되었습니다. 원격에서 path 및 fileName 인자 조작을 통해 악용될 수 있습니다.

CVE-2026-105158.description: A vulnerability was detected in RainyGao DocSys up to 2.02.85. The impacted element is the function BaseController.createDBForMysql of the file BaseController.java of the component Database Management. The manipulation of the argument url results in sql injection. The attack can be executed remotely. The exploit is now public and may be used. The project was informed of the problem early through an issue report but has not responded yet.
CVE-2026-105158.summary_ko: RainyGao DocSys 2.02.85 이하의 Database Management 구성 요소에서 URL 인자 조작으로 인한 SQL 삽입 취약점이 발견되었습니다.

CVE-2026-105205.description: SiYuan before 3.8.5 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows publish-mode readers to learn backlink block IDs and reference counts from password-protected and publish-disabled documents by querying a published document. Attackers can send POST requests to /api/block/getDocInfo or getDocsInfo for a published document ID to obtain refIDs and refCount of hidden referencing blocks, bypassing the publish confidentiality boundary.
CVE-2026-105205.summary_ko: SiYuan 3.8.5 이전 버전에는 비밀번호로 보호되거나 게시가 비활성화된 문서에서 백링크 블록 ID 및 참조 횟수를 노출하는 정보 유출 취약점이 존재합니다.

CVE-2026-105206.description: ZITADEL 3.0.0 through 3.4.15 and 4.x before 4.17.3 contains an incorrect authorization flaw in the User Service API, which verifies user.read against the caller's organization rather than the organization owning the target user. An authenticated member holding org-scoped user.read can query GET /v2/users/{userId}/authentication_methods to learn which authentication method types users in other organizations have registered.
CVE-2026-105206.summary_ko: ZITADEL 3.0.0부터 3.4.15까지 및 4.17.3 이전 4.x 버전의 User Service API에서 잘못된 권한 부여 결함이 발견되어, 인증된 사용자가 다른 조직의 인증 방법 유형을 조회할 수 있습니다.

CVE-2026-105207.description: ZITADEL 3.0.0 through 3.4.15 and 4.0.0 before 4.17.3 creates links between user accounts and external identity providers without verifying a primary factor or the caller's permission, including on identify-only Login V2 sessions and via the User Service V2 AddIDPLink endpoint. An unauthenticated attacker knowing a victim's login name can bind their own external IdP identity to the victim's account and then sign in as the victim.
CVE-2026-105207.summary_ko: ZITADEL은 외부 IDP와 사용자 계정을 연결할 때 기본 인증 요소나 호출 권한을 검증하지 않아, 공격자가 피해자 계정에 자신의 외부 IdP를 바인딩하고 로그인할 수 있는 취약점이 있습니다.

CVE-2026-105208.description: ZITADEL 4.x before 4.17.3 and 3.x through 3.4.15 protects IdP intent tokens with unauthenticated, malleable encryption, allowing authenticated users to tamper with their own token so it is accepted for another user's external login intent. An attacker who predicts a victim's in-flight intent identifier and wins a timing race can call /v2/idp_intents or /v2/sessions to steal the victim's IdP tokens or hijack their session.
CVE-2026-105208.summary_ko: ZITADEL은 IdP 인텐트 토큰을 취약하게 보호하여, 공격자가 토큰을 조작하고 세션을 탈취하여 다른 사용자의 외부 로그인에 악용할 수 있습니다.

CVE-2026-105209.description: ZITADEL 3.x before 3.4.15 and 4.x before 4.17.1 contains an improper authorization vulnerability: when issuing passkey or passwordless enrollment codes, it checks only the organization in the x-zitadel-orgid header, not the target user's organization. Attackers with user-write permission in one organization can obtain an enrollment code for a user in another organization on the same instance and register their own authenticator to take over that account.
CVE-2026-105209.summary_ko: ZITADEL은 패스키 등 등록 코드 발급 시 대상 사용자의 조직 대신 헤더의 조직만 확인하여, 다른 조직의 사용자 계정을 탈취할 수 있는 부적절한 인가 취약점이 있습니다.

CVE-2026-105210.description: ZITADEL 3.x before 3.4.15 and 4.x before 4.17.1 contains a missing authentication flaw in the hosted Login V1 UI, whose second-factor enrollment and initialization handlers act on an identify-only session before any primary factor is verified. Attackers knowing only a victim's login name can enroll attacker-controlled TOTP, OTP-SMS, OTP-Email, or U2F factors, overwrite the verified phone number, and enumerate users through discrepant errors.

CVE-2026-105211.description: ZITADEL before 4.17.1 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in Login V2 that allows unauthenticated attackers to take over accounts by obtaining OTP codes via the returnCode delivery type. Attackers knowing a login name of a victim with OTP-Email and OTP-SMS enrolled can read both codes from server-action responses to gain MFA-authenticated sessions, including administrator takeover.
CVE-2026-105211.summary_ko: ZITADEL Login V2는 서버 액션 응답에서 OTP 코드를 읽어와 관리자 계정을 포함한 MFA 인증 세션을 탈취할 수 있는 인증 우회 취약점이 있습니다.

CVE-2026-105212.description: ZITADEL 3.x before 3.4.14 and 4.x before 4.16.2 contains an authentication bypass in the hosted Login V1 and Login V2 UIs that accepts passkey or other authenticator enrollment on identify-only login sessions, before any primary factor is verified. Unauthenticated attackers knowing only a victim's login name can register an attacker-controlled authenticator and log in as that user, bypassing existing passwords and MFA.
CVE-2026-105212.summary_ko: ZITADEL은 로그인 세션에서 기본 요소가 검증되기 전에 패스키 등 인증기 등록을 허용하여, 공격자가 비밀번호와 MFA를 우회하고 로그인할 수 있는 취약점이 있습니다.

CVE-2026-105213.description: ZITADEL 4.x before 4.17.1 does not check an organization's inactive state during Login V2 authentication, verifying only the individual user's status. Users of a deactivated organization who hold valid credentials, an existing session, or a refresh token can still sign in, create sessions, and obtain or refresh tokens.
CVE-2026-105213.summary_ko: ZITADEL Login V2는 인증 시 조직의 비활성화 상태를 확인하지 않아, 비활성화된 조직의 사용자가 여전히 로그인하고 토큰을 갱신할 수 있는 취약점이 있습니다.

CVE-2026-105214.description: Zitadel before 4.16.2 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows attackers to make the server request internal resources through organization domain HTTP verification. The challenge fetch uses Go's default http.Get instead of the protected client, so attackers can register domains that redirect to loopback, internal, or cloud metadata addresses to scan ports and map internal networks.
CVE-2026-105214.summary_ko: Zitadel 4.16.2 이전 버전에는 조직 도메인 HTTP 검증 과정에서 서버가 내부 리소스를 요청하게 만드는 서버 측 요청 위조 취약점이 포함되어 있습니다.

CVE-2026-105215.description: ZITADEL before 3.4.14 and 4.x before 4.16.2 contains an authentication bypass in the hosted Login V1 UI because the 'external account not found' registration endpoint trusts client-supplied external identity fields without a completed IdP callback. Unauthenticated attackers can submit forged IDPConfigID and ExternalUserID values to pre-create an account bound to a victim's external IdP identity, which the victim's later genuine external login then signs into.
CVE-2026-105215.summary_ko: ZITADEL Login V1 UI는 외부 계정 미발견 등록 엔드포인트가 외부 IdP 콜백 없이 클라이언트가 제공한 필드를 신뢰하여 인증을 우회할 수 있는 취약점이 있습니다.

CVE-2026-104402.description: Insertion of Sensitive Information Into Sent Data vulnerability in farvisun Mindio Magic MCP mindio-magic-mcp allows Retrieve Embedded Sensitive Data.This issue affects Mindio Magic MCP: from n/a through 0.5.6.

CVE-2026-105086.description: WWBN AVideo 12.4 through 29.2.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows authenticated uploaders to inject HTML by submitting doubly-encoded entities in video titles. Because safeString() strips tags before decoding entities and runs twice via setTitle() and save(), attackers can store markup that executes in trending, gallery, embed, and playlist pages.
CVE-2026-105086.summary_ko: WWBN AVideo는 비디오 제목에 이중 인코딩된 엔티티를 제출하여 HTML을 주입할 수 있는 저장형 크로스 사이트 스크립팅 취약점이 있습니다.

CVE-2026-105089.description: WWBN AVideo through 29.2.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows users with upload permission to inject script by setting a malicious video trailer1 URL. The value is rendered unescaped in YouPHPFlix2 templates and channel playlists, letting attackers break out of onclick strings or iframe src attributes to execute JavaScript in victims' browsers.
CVE-2026-105089.summary_ko: WWBN AVideo는 악성 비디오 트레일러 URL을 설정하여 사용자가 스크립트를 주입하고 피해자의 브라우저에서 자바스크립트를 실행할 수 있는 저장형 크로스 사이트 스크립팅 취약점이 있습니다.

CVE-2026-105224.description: YesWiki before 4.6.7 contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability in the Bazar valeur action that allows page editors to inject script by rendering unescaped HTML fetched from a remote URL. Attackers can point tools/bazar/actions/valeur.php at a controlled server returning BAZ_fiche_titre markup with an img onerror handler, executing script in every viewer's browser.
CVE-2026-105224.summary_ko: YesWiki 4.6.7 이전 버전의 Bazar valeur 액션에는 원격 URL에서 가져온 이스케이프되지 않은 HTML을 렌더링하여 스크립트를 주입할 수 있는 크로스 사이트 스크립팅 취약점이 존재합니다.

CVE-2026-105161.description: A flaw has been found in invariant-systems-ai aiir up to 1.7.0. The affected element is an unknown function of the component Policy Gate Handler. Executing a manipulation can lead to improper verification of cryptographic signature. The attack can be executed remotely. It is advisable to upgrade the affected component. The GitHub repository of this project is not available anymore. This vulnerability only affects products that are no longer supported by the maintainer.
CVE-2026-105161.summary_ko: invariant-systems-ai aiir 1.7.0 이하의 Policy Gate Handler 구성 요소에서 부적절한 암호화 서명 검증으로 인한 결함이 발견되었습니다.

CVE-2026-105216.description: go-micro before 6.0.0 contains an improper certificate validation vulnerability that allows network attackers to impersonate services because the shared TLS helper sets InsecureSkipVerify to true by default. Man-in-the-middle attackers can present any certificate to intercept or modify gRPC transport, HTTP and RabbitMQ broker, and Consul or etcd registry traffic, including authentication tokens and credentials.
CVE-2026-105216.summary_ko: go-micro는 공유 TLS 헬퍼가 기본적으로 InsecureSkipVerify를 참으로 설정하여 부적절한 인증서 검증이 발생하며, 네트워크 중간자 공격자가 서비스를 가장할 수 있습니다.

CVE-2026-105217.description: Cockpit CMS 2.12.0 before 2.14.1 disables TLS certificate verification in the cron.php web worker restart request, allowing network attackers to capture the worker token. Man-in-the-middle attackers on the outbound path to site_url can present any certificate to steal the worker/web/token value and start the web worker.

CVE-2026-105218.description: gopay before 1.5.119 disables TLS certificate verification in defaultClient() in pkg/xhttp/client.go, allowing man-in-the-middle attackers to impersonate payment provider APIs. Attackers can present any certificate to read merchant credentials, signatures and transaction data, and modify payment, refund and order query responses.
CVE-2026-105218.summary_ko: gopay는 기본 클라이언트에서 TLS 인증서 검증을 비활성화하여, 중간자 공격자가 결제 제공자 API를 가장하고 자격 증명과 거래 데이터를 가로채거나 수정할 수 있습니다.

CVE-2026-105219.description: Mammoth.js 1.3.0 before 1.12.3 contains a regular expression denial of service vulnerability in the style map tokeniser in lib/styles/parser/tokeniser.js due to overlapping regex alternatives. Attackers can supply a crafted .docx with an unterminated quoted string of repeated backslash escapes in mammoth/style-map to block the Node.js event loop.
CVE-2026-105219.summary_ko: Mammoth.js는 스타일 맵 토크나이저의 정규식 문제로 인해 제작된 .docx 파일을 통해 노드 이벤트 루프를 차단할 수 있는 정규식 서비스 거부 취약점이 있습니다.

CVE-2026-105163.description: A vulnerability was detected in crossplane crossplane-runtime up to 2.2.2/2.3.2. This vulnerability affects the function Get of the file pkg/xpkg/client.go of the component ImageConfig. The manipulation results in time-of-check time-of-use. The attack may be launched remotely. Upgrading to version 2.2.3, 2.3.3 and 2.4.0-rc.1 is able to resolve this issue. The patch is identified as bee99c6cd6ca81878acca2940a2f0a02169fc208. You should upgrade the affected component.
CVE-2026-105163.summary_ko: crossplane-runtime의 pkg/xpkg/client.go 내 ImageConfig 컴포넌트에서 검사 시점과 사용 시점(TOCTOU) 취약점이 발견되었습니다. 원격으로 공격이 수행될 수 있습니다.

CVE-2026-105164.description: A flaw has been found in NASA cFS up to 7.0.1. This issue affects the function CFE_FS_ParseInputFileNameEx of the file cfe/modules/fs/fsw/src/cfe_fs_api.c. This manipulation causes out-of-bounds read. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. The pull request to fix this issue awaits acceptance.

CVE-2026-105165.description: A vulnerability has been found in devopspolis secrets-replicator up to 0.4.0. Impacted is the function process_single_secret of the file src/handler.py of the component AssumeRole Handler. Such manipulation of the argument external_id leads to incorrect permission assignment. The attack can be executed remotely. Upgrading to version 0.5.0 is recommended to address this issue. The name of the patch is b42239405fbf4fae3c3f0048fc0b4225112edceb. It is suggested to upgrade the affected component.

CVE-2026-105166.description: A vulnerability was found in kishor-23 food-waste-management-system 411989e3ecb82895e53dca7865f72145f03d7d93/b3a70b2c492dc9904de5be1ad9389bd79b87f82c. The affected element is the function insert of the file fooddonateform.php of the component Food Donation Form. Performing a manipulation of the argument image-choice results in sql injection. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. The exploit has been made public and could be used. This product adopts a rolling release strategy to maintain continuous delivery. Therefore, version details for affected or updated releases cannot be specified. The project was informed of the problem early through an issue report but has not responded yet.

CVE-2026-105167.description: A vulnerability was determined in kishor-23 food-waste-management-system 411989e3ecb82895e53dca7865f72145f03d7d93/b3a70b2c492dc9904de5be1ad9389bd79b87f82c. The impacted element is an unknown function of the file admin/donate.php. Executing a manipulation of the argument location can lead to sql injection. The attack may be performed from remote. The exploit has been publicly disclosed and may be utilized. This product utilizes a rolling release system for continuous delivery, and as such, version information for affected or updated releases is not disclosed. The project was informed of the problem early through an issue report but has not responded yet.

CVE-2026-105220.description: Twine 2 desktop through 2.12.0 contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability in importStories() that executes markup from imported story files in the editor window. Attackers can craft a story file whose script calls the twineElectron openWithScratchFile IPC bridge to write and open a .bat file, executing code as the user.
CVE-2026-105220.summary_ko: Twine 2 데스크톱의 importStories() 함수에서 크로스 사이트 스크립팅(XSS) 취약점이 존재합니다. 공격자는 이를 악용해 제작된 스토리 파일을 통해 코드를 실행할 수 있습니다.

CVE-2026-105221.description: The gist RubyGem before 6.1.0 contains an improper certificate validation vulnerability that allows on-path attackers to intercept HTTPS traffic because http_connection in lib/gist.rb sets VERIFY_NONE. Attackers can present any certificate to read or modify GitHub API traffic, stealing OAuth tokens and login credentials to read and modify the victim's gists.

CVE-2026-105222.description: The alexpechkarev/google-maps Laravel package through 12.16 disables TLS certificate verification by default because the bundled config sets ssl_verify_peer to FALSE, which is passed to CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYPEER. On-path attackers can present any certificate to intercept Google Maps web-service requests, steal the API key from the query string, and tamper with responses.

CVE-2026-105168.description: A vulnerability was identified in kishor-23 food-waste-management-system 411989e3ecb82895e53dca7865f72145f03d7d93/b3a70b2c492dc9904de5be1ad9389bd79b87f82c. This affects an unknown function of the file admin/admin.php of the component Order Assignment Block. The manipulation of the argument order_id/delivery_person_id leads to sql injection. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. The exploit is publicly available and might be used. This product is using a rolling release to provide continious delivery. Therefore, no version details for affected nor updated releases are available. The project was informed of the problem early through an issue report but has not responded yet.

CVE-2026-105169.description: A security flaw has been discovered in kishor-23 food-waste-management-system 411989e3ecb82895e53dca7865f72145f03d7d93/b3a70b2c492dc9904de5be1ad9389bd79b87f82c. This impacts an unknown function of the file delivery/delivery.php of the component Take Order Handler. The manipulation of the argument order_id/delivery_person_id results in sql injection. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The exploit has been released to the public and may be used for attacks. This product takes the approach of rolling releases to provide continious delivery. Therefore, version details for affected and updated releases are not available. The project was informed of the problem early through an issue report but has not responded yet.

CVE-2026-105170.description: A weakness has been identified in kishor-23 food-waste-management-system 411989e3ecb82895e53dca7865f72145f03d7d93/b3a70b2c492dc9904de5be1ad9389bd79b87f82c. Affected is an unknown function of the file admin/signup.php of the component Admin Signup. This manipulation of the argument sign causes missing authentication. The attack can be initiated remotely. The exploit has been made available to the public and could be used for attacks. Continious delivery with rolling releases is used by this product. Therefore, no version details of affected nor updated releases are available. The project was informed of the problem early through an issue report but has not responded yet.

CVE-2026-105171.description: A security vulnerability has been detected in kishor-23 food-waste-management-system 411989e3ecb82895e53dca7865f72145f03d7d93/b3a70b2c492dc9904de5be1ad9389bd79b87f82c. Affected by this vulnerability is an unknown functionality of the file admin/admin.php of the component Role Attribute Handler. Such manipulation of the argument Name leads to authorization bypass. The attack can be launched remotely. The exploit has been disclosed publicly and may be used. This product does not use versioning. This is why information about affected and unaffected releases are unavailable. Multiple endpoints are affected. The project was informed of the problem early through an issue report but has not responded yet.

CVE-2026-105172.description: A vulnerability was detected in itsourcecode Online Admission System 1.0. Affected by this issue is some unknown functionality of the file /login1.php. Performing a manipulation of the argument User results in sql injection. The attack may be initiated remotely. The exploit is now public and may be used.

CVE-2026-105173.description: A flaw has been found in code-projects Human Resource Management 1.0. This affects an unknown part of the file /humanresourcemanagementsystem/src/store/EventStore.php of the component Event Creation. Executing a manipulation of the argument eventSubject can lead to cross site scripting. The attack may be launched remotely. The exploit has been published and may be used.

CVE-2026-105174.description: A vulnerability has been found in Gerapy up to 0.9.13. This vulnerability affects the function project_create of the file gerapy/server/core/views.py of the component Project Management. The manipulation of the argument project_name leads to path traversal. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used. The identifier of the patch is 6e481078cfba6388a67ca2d9792288405019ba3e. Applying a patch is the recommended action to fix this issue.

CVE-2026-105175.description: A vulnerability was found in SourceCodester Drug Recommendation System 1.0. This issue affects some unknown processing of the file /Auth/add_student.php of the component Student Registration. The manipulation of the argument cmdschool results in sql injection. The attack can be executed remotely. The exploit has been made public and could be used.

CVE-2026-105223.description: maclof kubernetes-client 0.17.0 before 0.32.0 disables TLS certificate verification in parseKubeconfig() and parseKubeconfigFile() when a kubeconfig lacks certificate-authority-data, ignoring insecure-skip-tls-verify. On-path attackers can impersonate the Kubernetes API server to capture Bearer tokens or Basic credentials and tamper with WebSocket or REST API traffic.
CVE-2026-105223.summary_ko: maclof kubernetes-client에서 인증서 권한 데이터가 없을 때 TLS 인증서 검증이 비활성화되는 문제가 있습니다. 경로상 공격자가 API 서버를 사칭하여 토큰과 자격 증명을 탈취할 수 있습니다.

CVE-2026-105292.description: Chaterm before 0.12.1 contains a login cross-site request forgery vulnerability that allows remote attackers to inject login state by sending chaterm:// callbacks without OAuth state validation. Attackers can trigger a crafted callback with attacker-controlled userInfo from a web page, signing the victim into the attacker's account so default data sync uploads saved hosts, passwords, and private keys.
CVE-2026-105292.summary_ko: Chaterm에서 OAuth 상태 검증 없이 chaterm:// 콜백을 허용하여 로그인 크로스 사이트 요청 위조(CSRF) 취약점이 발생합니다. 공격자는 이를 통해 피해자를 공격자의 계정에 로그인시킬 수 있습니다.

CVE-2026-105293.description: Legcord 1.1.0 through 1.3.0 contains a path traversal vulnerability in theme IPC handlers that allows script in the Discord page to escape the themes directory via unvalidated theme ids. Attackers running script in the Discord origin, such as through XSS, can abuse themes.folder, themes.uninstall, and themes.install to launch local executables, recursively delete directories, and write files outside the themes directory.
CVE-2026-105293.summary_ko: Legcord의 테마 IPC 핸들러에서 경로 순회 취약점이 존재합니다. 공격자는 이를 악용하여 로컬 실행 파일을 실행하고 디렉터리를 삭제하거나 파일을 쓸 수 있습니다.

CVE-2026-105294.description: Legcord 1.1.0 through 1.3.0 contains a configuration injection vulnerability that allows script in the Discord page to write any config key via the window.legcord settings.setConfig bridge. Attackers exploiting a Discord XSS can set additionalArguments to persistently add --proxy-server and --ignore-certificate-errors switches, routing all client traffic through an interception proxy.

CVE-2026-105295.description: GitAhead 2.5.0 through 2.7.1 contains an insecure update mechanism that installs downloaded updates without integrity or signature verification and permanently ignores TLS errors after one SSL error dialog. Network attackers presenting an invalid certificate once can intercept later automatic update checks, offer a fake version, and execute code as the user upon installation.
CVE-2026-105295.summary_ko: GitAhead의 불안정한 업데이트 메커니즘으로 인해 무결성이나 서명 검증 없이 다운로드된 업데이트가 설치됩니다. 네트워크 공격자는 이를 가로채 가짜 버전을 제공하고 코드를 실행할 수 있습니다.

CVE-2026-105176.description: A vulnerability was determined in SourceCodester Drug Recommendation System 1.0. Impacted is an unknown function of the file /Admin/edit_class.php. This manipulation of the argument ID causes sql injection. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. The exploit has been publicly disclosed and may be utilized.

CVE-2026-105177.description: A vulnerability was identified in SourceCodester Drug Recommendation System 1.0. The affected element is an unknown function of the file /Admin/add_drug.php of the component Drug Creation. Such manipulation of the argument txtname/cmdtype/txtusage/txtsideeffect/cmdcontraindication leads to sql injection. The attack may be performed from remote. The exploit is publicly available and might be used.

CVE-2026-105178.description: A security flaw has been discovered in SourceCodester Drug Recommendation System 1.0. The impacted element is the function mysqli_real_escape_string of the file /Admin/add_symptom.php of the component Symptom Creation. Performing a manipulation of the argument txtname results in sql injection. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. The exploit has been released to the public and may be used for attacks.

CVE-2026-105179.description: A weakness has been identified in SourceCodester Drug Recommendation System 1.0. This affects an unknown function of the file Admin/add_user.php of the component Password Handler. Executing a manipulation of the argument Password can lead to missing encryption of sensitive data. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The exploit has been made available to the public and could be used for attacks.

CVE-2026-105180.description: A vulnerability was determined in Jeebase 0.0.1. This vulnerability affects the function updateUser of the file /user/update/info of the component UserService. Executing a manipulation of the argument user/tempUser can lead to dynamically-determined object attributes. The attack can be executed remotely. The exploit has been publicly disclosed and may be utilized. The project was informed of the problem early through an issue report but has not responded yet.

summary.title_ko: 오픈소스 음성 복제 및 스튜디오 툴 VoiceStudio

summary.title_ko: Claude Code와 Codex를 통합 실행하는 다중 에이전트 하네스 openrig

summary.title_ko: 한선케이의 인생 진阶指南 및 AI 학습 가이드 저장소
summary.summary_ko: 개인 진로 가이드 및 AI와 영어 학습 자료를 모아둔 저장소이다.

summary.title_ko: 오픈소스 저비용 10.5 GHz PLFM 위상 배열 레이더 시스템
summary.summary_ko: 오픈소스로 공개된 저비용 10.5 GHz 주파수 기반의 PLFM 위상 배열 레이더 시스템 저장소이다.

summary.title_ko: 자율형 AI 에이전트를 위한 안전한 런타임 'OpenShell'
summary.summary_ko: OpenShell은 자율형 AI 에이전트의 안전과 프라이버시를 보장하기 위해 설계된 런타임 저장소이다.

summary.title_ko: 벡터 없는 추론 기반 RAG를 위한 문서 색인 저장소
summary.summary_ko: VectifyAI의 PageIndex는 벡터 임베딩에 의존하지 않고 추론 기반의 검색 증강 생성(RAG)을 수행하기 위한 문서 색인 오픈소스 저장소다.

summary.title_ko: 다양한 데이터베이스를 지원하는 경량 크로스플랫폼 클라이언트 dbx
summary.summary_ko: MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQLite, Redis, MongoDB 등을 포함한 100개 이상의 데이터베이스를 지원하는 25MB 경량 크로스플랫폼 데이터베이스 클라이언트다. 내장 AI, MCP 서버, CLI, 데스크톱 및 도커 환경을 제공한다.

summary.title_ko: mattpocock/skills 저장소
summary.summary_ko: 실제 엔지니어들을 위한 실무 기술과 에이전트 디렉토리 기반의 내용을 담고 있는 오픈소스 저장소입니다.

summary.title_ko: DietrichGebert/ponytail 오픈소스 저장소

summary.title_ko: heygen-com/hyperframes

summary.title_ko: AI 대형 모델과 자동화 워크플로우를 활용한 고화질 숏폼 생성 도구 MoneyPrinterTurbo

summary.title_ko: 오픈클로(openclaw/openclaw) 오픈소스 저장소

summary.title_ko: Claude AI 워크플로우 커스텀을 위한 유용한 기술 및 자원 모음

summary.title_ko: 코드 변경 자동 동기화 기능을 갖춘 사전 색인화 코드 지식 그래프

summary.title_ko: AI 코딩 에이전트를 위한 컨텍스트 윈도우 최적화 도구

summary.title_ko: 클로드 코드, 코덱스, 피 기반의 에이전트 네트워크 구축 저장소 'openrig'

summary.title_ko: pablostanley/yoinks
summary.summary_ko: 터미널에서 비디오를 다운로드하는 오픈소스 저장소로, 보안이나 심층 AI 연구와는 직접적인 관련이 적어 제외한다.

summary.title_ko: earendil-works/pi
summary.summary_ko: 통합 LLM API, 에이전트 루프, 터미널 사용자 인터페이스(TUI), 코딩 에이전트 CLI 기능을 제공하는 AI 에이전트 툴킷 저장소이다.

summary.title_ko: 다양한 스켈레톤 애니메이션을 위한 통합 모델 UniMate
summary.summary_ko: SIGGRAPH Asia 2026에 채택된 UniMate는 다양한 스켈레톤을 애니메이션화하기 위한 하나의 통합 인공지능 모델을 제공하는 오픈소스 저장소다. 관련 연구 및 모델 구현 코드를 GitHub를 통해 제공한다.

summary.title_ko: Cursor 플러그인 사양 및 공식 플러그인 저장소
summary.summary_ko: Cursor 코드 에디터의 공식 플러그인 사양과 관련 플러그인들을 제공하는 깃허브 오픈소스 저장소입니다.

summary.title_ko: 고성능 GPU 및 CPU 커널 개발을 위한 도메인 특화 언어 'TileLang'
summary.summary_ko: TileLang은 고성능 GPU, CPU 및 가속기 커널 개발을 간소화하기 위해 설계된 도메인 특화 언어(DSL)입니다. 개발자들이 다양한 하드웨어 가속기용 커널을 보다 효율적으로 작성하고 최적화할 수 있도록 지원하는 깃허브 오픈소스 프로젝트입니다.

summary.title_ko: AI 에이전트에 인터넷 검색 기능을 부여하는 오픈소스 도구 'Agent-Reach'
summary.summary_ko: 트위터, 레딧, 유튜브, 깃허브 등 다양한 플랫폼의 데이터를 AI 에이전트가 단일 CLI와 무료로 검색하고 읽을 수 있도록 지원하는 오픈소스 저장소 프로젝트다.

summary.title_ko: 코딩 에이전트의 토큰 사용량을 대폭 줄여주는 JuliusBrussee/caveman
summary.summary_ko: 원시적인 화법을 모방하여 코딩 에이전트와 통신할 때 토큰 소비를 대폭 줄여주는 프록시 및 스킬 저장소다. 불필요한 토큰 낭비를 막고 효율적으로 프롬프트를 처리할 수 있도록 돕는다.

summary.title_ko: 클로드 코드 및 AI 에이전트를 위한 마케팅 기술 저장소
summary.summary_ko: 본 저장소는 전환율 최적화(CRO), 카피라이팅, SEO, 분석 및 성장 엔지니어링 등 Claude Code 및 AI 에이전트 구동에 필요한 마케팅 기술 자료를 제공한다.

summary.title_ko: 구글 제품 및 기술을 위한 에이전트 스킬 저장소
summary.summary_ko: 구글 제품 및 기술과 연동하여 동작하는 에이전트 스킬을 제공하는 오픈소스 저장소입니다. 관련 기술 생태계에서 유용하게 활용될 수 있습니다.

summary.title_ko: Effect-TS/effect
summary.summary_ko: 타입스크립트 애플리케이션 빌드를 위한 오픈소스 저장소입니다.

summary.title_ko: getsentry/sentry 저장소
summary.summary_ko: 개발자를 위한 오류 추적 및 성능 모니터링 오픈소스 프로젝트입니다. 애플리케이션의 실시간 이슈 감지 및 분석 기능을 제공합니다.

summary.title_ko: AI 에이전트 성능 최적화 시스템 affaan-m/ECC 공개
summary.summary_ko: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor 등에서 활용할 수 있는 에이전트 하네스 성능 최적화 시스템 저장소이다. 기술, 보안, 연구 중심의 개발을 지원하는 기능들을 포함하고 있다.

summary.title_ko: OpenCut: 오픈소스 CapCut 대안
summary.summary_ko: OpenCut은 인기 영상 편집 프로그램인 CapCut을 대체하기 위해 개발된 오픈소스 프로젝트다. 사용자가 자유롭게 영상 편집 기능을 활용하고 수정할 수 있도록 소스 코드를 제공한다.

summary.title_ko: addyosmani/agent-skills
summary.summary_ko: AI 코딩 에이전트를 위한 프로덕션 급 엔지니어링 기술과 모범 사례를 담은 저장소다. 개발자가 에이전트를 활용해 코딩 작업을 수행할 때 필요한 실용적인 방법론과 스킬을 제공한다.

summary.title_ko: anthropics/claude-code
summary.summary_ko: 터미널 환경에서 실행되는 에이전트 기반 코딩 도구로, 코드베이스를 이해하고 자연어 명령을 통해 반복적인 작업, 복잡한 코드 설명, 깃 워크플로우를 지원한다. 개발자가 더 빠르게 코딩할 수 있도록 돕는 실용적인 터미널 인터페이스 에이전트 저장소다.

summary.title_ko: 클로드용 세션 간 지속형 컨텍스트 관리 저장소 thedotmack/claude-mem
summary.summary_ko: AI 에이전트의 세션 활동을 기록하고 AI로 압축하여 향후 세션에 관련 컨텍스트를 주입하는 저장소입니다. Claude Code, OpenClaw, Codex, Gemini 등 다양한 도구와 연동됩니다.

summary.title_ko: Cloudflare Workers 기반 에이전트 워크스페이스 cloudflare/cloudflare-os
summary.summary_ko: 기업의 컨텍스트와 시스템을 활용해 문서를 만들고 앱을 구축하며 에이전트를 실행할 수 있는 Cloudflare Workers 기반의 작업 공간 저장소입니다.
